name: agentic-llm-scaling-knowledge-pack
title: Agentic LLM Scaling Knowledge Pack
description: A curated knowledge pack covering two research areas in scaling LLM-based systems: (1) MapReduce-style agentic workflows, including Cognition's Devin Security Swarm and related arXiv literature (A-MapReduce, LLM x MapReduce V1-V3, ToM, Agentics 2.0, Scepsy), and (2) Tree-of-Thoughts reasoning scaling, including the original ToT framework, Graph of Thoughts, and Path-of-Thoughts, with a comparative analysis and hybrid design recommendation.
